title: Hilton Reports Third Quarter Results
summary: MCLEAN, VA ‑ Hilton Worldwide Holdings Inc. ("Hilton," "the Company," "we," "us" or "our") (NYSE: HLT) today reported its third quarter 2026 results.
body_markdown:

**MCLEAN, VA** - Hilton Worldwide Holdings Inc. ("Hilton," "the Company," "we," "us" or "our") (NYSE: HLT) today reported its third quarter 2026 results. Highlights include:


- Diluted EPS was $2.37 for the third quarter, and diluted EPS, adjusted for special items, was $2.45
- Net income was $536 million for the third quarter
- Adjusted EBITDA was $1,058 million for the third quarter
- System-wide comparable RevPAR increased 5.8 percent, on a currency neutral basis, for the third quarter compared to the same period in 2025
- Approved 30,500 new rooms for development during the third quarter, bringing our development pipeline to 543,100 rooms as of September 30, 2026, representing growth of 5 percent from September 30, 2025
- Added 27,000 rooms to our system, resulting in 23,000 net additional rooms for the third quarter, up 6.5 percent sequentially from the second quarter, contributing to net unit growth of 6.0 percent from September 30, 2025
- Announced the appointment of Jeff Moore as Executive Vice President and Chief Technology Officer. Jeff will harness his deep experience developing consumer-facing technologies and Hilton’s already-industry-leading technology platform to strengthen the Company's commitment to lead the industry in technology innovation
- On October 20, announced that Hilton will transfer its stock listing to Nasdaq under its existing ticker, "HLT," effective November 5, 2026. The move aligns with the Company's innovation and growth ambitions, and no action is required by shareholders
- Repurchased 2.6 million shares of Hilton common stock during the third quarter, bringing total capital return, including dividends, to $879 million for the quarter and $2,902 million year to date through October
- Full year 2026 system-wide RevPAR is projected to increase between 4.0 percent and 4.5 percent on a comparable and currency neutral basis compared to 2025; full year net income is projected to be between $1,909 million and $1,923 million; full year Adjusted EBITDA is projected to be between $4,060 million and $4,080 million
- Full year 2026 capital return is projected to be approximately $3.5 billion

## About Hilton


Hilton (NYSE: HLT) is a leading global hospitality company with a portfolio of 28 world-class brands comprising more than 9,600 properties and over 1.4 million rooms, in 144 countries and territories. Dedicated to fulfilling its founding vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality, Hilton has welcomed over 4 billion guests in its more than 100-year history. Named as the No. 1 World’s Best Workplace by Great Place to Work and Fortune, Hilton aims to create the best culture for its 500,000 team members around the world. Hilton has introduced industry-leading technology enhancements to improve the guest experience, including Digital Key Share, automated complimentary room upgrades and the ability to book confirmed connecting rooms. Through the award-winning guest loyalty program Hilton Honors, the more than 270


million Hilton Honors members who book directly with Hilton can earn Points for hotel stays and experiences money can't buy. With the free[Hilton Honors app](https://www.hilton.com/en/p/hilton-honors-mobile-app/) , guests can book their stay, select their room, check in, unlock their door with a Digital Key and check out, all from their smartphone.
